summary: Backend + Frontend regression testing for FrameForge Windows Services card + Startup detection fix (anti-Defender). 6/7 backend tests pass. Frontend fully verified: services-card visible on /app/pc with correct DiagTrack=disattiva and Fax=gia_ok mapping; startup section shows '1 active · 1 already disabled' counts with Discord (ACTIVE badge) on top and Steam (DISABLED, dimmed) at bottom. Both cards persist after reload. PowerShell agent script parses cleanly (>5900 lines, ~300KB) and contains all required functions (Get-ServicesAudit, Get-StartupList, _lnkTarget, StartupApproved) with NO 'WScript' references. HOWEVER, one 'ComObject' reference is still present in Get-CleanableMb (line 398, New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application for Recycle Bin size). Per spec the string 'ComObject' must not appear anywhere in the script.

minor.issue: Line 398 in /app/backend/ps_agent.py (Get-CleanableMb) still uses 'New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application' to enumerate the Recycle Bin. Spec requires the script to contain no ComObject reference at all (anti-Defender). This function runs during Get-Health (each report), not only during scan, so it could still be flagged by Defender heuristics. Replace with alternative (e.g. read %USERPROFILE%\$Recycle.Bin size via Get-ChildItem, or drop RB size entirely).

action_items: Remove the last 'New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application' from /app/backend/ps_agent.py Get-CleanableMb (line 398) to fully honour the anti-Defender guarantee promised in the bug fix note.
Optional: add a CI-level guard test that greps ps_agent.py for 'ComObject' / 'WScript' so this doesn't regress.
critical_code_review_comments: ps_agent.py is 6021 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. It should be split into modules (health, startup, services, benchmark, sync) and assembled via includes.
Anti-Defender promise is only partially delivered: WScript.Shell removed, ComObject partially removed (Get-StartupList clean, Get-CleanableMb still uses Shell.Application).
analyze_services in services_kb.py is deterministic and well structured; good separation from LLM.
seed_data_creation: Test posted mock services_audit (DiagTrack running, Fax stopped) and startup list (Discord enabled, Steam disabled) via /api/agent/report-specs for the admin user in pc_specs collection. These are the same records shown in the frontend screenshots.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only outstanding issue is line 398 ComObject usage in Get-CleanableMb. Everything else — PS parser (pwsh at /opt/pwsh/pwsh), services E2E flow, startup E2E flow (Steam filtered out from AI call), UI services-card + startup ordering with counts and Attivo/Disattivato badges — is verified working. AI call count for startup analyze is 1 (single POST triggers a single ai_engine.analyze_startup).
rca of the issue: The bug fix note claims 'nessun oggetto COM shell nello scan' and removed WScript.Shell/COM from Get-StartupList (now uses _lnkTarget with byte-read + regex — verified). But Get-CleanableMb still instantiates Shell.Application to sum Recycle Bin items. It runs on every Get-Health cycle, so Defender may still see a ComObject shell instantiation from the agent process and quarantine, defeating the stated fix goal. Mitigation: read %SystemDrive%\$Recycle.Bin\<SID>\ file sizes directly with Get-ChildItem -Force, or omit RB from cleanable estimate.
